descriptions.description: Note: Several authors (e. g. Jafri in Jafri & El-Gadi, Fl. Libya 86: 167. 1980; Devesa in Mem. Soc. Brot. 28: 19. 1988) have treated Herb. Linn. 896.9 (LINN) as the type, but this collection lacks a Species Plantarum number (i. e. " 6 "), is a post- 1753 addition to the herbarium, and is not original material for the name.
" Habitat in Europae australis maritimis. " RCN: 5271.
Lectotype (Foerther in Turland & Jarvis in Taxon 46: 478. 1997): Herb. A. van Royen No. 908.120 - 1904 (L).
